metadata.question: Were there fires in Pedrógão Grande during the any time between June 16 to June 20, 2017?

data.raw_code: We need to answer: "Were there fires in Pedrógão Grande during any time between June 16 to June 20, 2017?" Key steps: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Pedrógão Grande, Portugal. We'll use coordinates (39.9167, -8.1667) with a 10km buffer to cover the municipality. - Date: June 16 to June 20, 2017. - Data: Use VIIRS active fire data (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGDL) which has good fire detection for 2017. 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS fire data has a 'FireMask' band with values: 0=not processed, 1=water, 2=cloud, 3=non-fire, 4=fire (low), 5=fire (nominal), 6=fire (high). - We'll consider any pixel with FireMask >=4 as a fire pixel. 3. Logic: - Check if collection is empty → C1. - Count fire pixels in the region. - If count > 0 → A (Yes). - If count == 0 → B (No). - If count is null/undefined → C3. We should also print intermediate stats: number of images and fire pixel count. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry (Pedrógão Grande, Portugal) const pedrogaoGrande = ee.Geometry.Point([-8.1667, 39.9167]); const region = pedrogaoGrande.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer // 2. Define date range const startDate = '2017-06-16'; const endDate = '2017-06-20'; // 3. Load VIIRS active fire data const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGDL') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); // Check collection size const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Number of VIIRS images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // No images found console.log('C1: No fire detection data available for the given date/location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Process fire data // Create a composite with maximum FireMask value (to capture any fire pixels) const composite = fireCollection.select('FireMask').max(); // Create fire mask (FireMask >= 4 indicates fire) const fireMask = composite.gte(4); // Count fire pixels in the region const fireCount = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Fire pixel count: ${fireCount}`); // 5. Validate and output answer if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined) { console.log('C3: Could not calculate fire count.'); console.log('C3'); } else if (fireCount > 0) { console.log('A: Fire detected.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B: No fire detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
